beat_title: The gun fires. The tanks are full.
key_claim: Muscle glycogen ~150–200 mmol/kg wet muscle in a carbohydrate-loaded runner

Sweat 0.92–0.99 L/h (warm marathon); drift ~+10 bpm at 1:00 (+15 bpm over 45–60 min in lab heat); runners underestimate sweat loss by 42.5%; hot-humid rate up to 1.5 L/h; one elite Dubai winner 3.6 L/h and −9.8% body mass

beat_title: Halfway for Priya: half the tank gone.
key_claim: Glycogen burn ~5 mmol/kg/km; 21 km ≈ 105 mmol/kg of ~200 loaded; full 42.2 km ≈ 210 mmol/kg
4:16/km → km 30–35 at 2:08–2:29; metabolic model predicts the wall at mile 21 (80–95% VO2max); sub-3:00 men wall rate 1.42%; 82% even-pace

beat_title: Louise is in the medical tent.

4:30; 17.2% of Boston finishers over 4:30; median 3:46; wall at mile 20; second half 27 min slower (12.2% of field); pacing-defined wall 28% men / 17% women (4M+ records)
